known_limits: One authored master triangle per slave sample; this is not a global closest-surface search or broadphase.

One-contact-per-slave behavior remains required to avoid duplicate tributary area.
No full-scene integration, anatomical surface coverage, timestep stability, multi-contact manifold, or complete FEM solve was tested.
Triangle sample mode is opt-in and is not attached unconditionally to a scene.
